out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed paper towel dispenser in bakery station unable to dispense paper towels.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC placed paper towels at hand sink.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed hand soap dispenser near mop sink unable to dispense soap.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC placed hand soap pump at hand sink.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: all dishes washed at dish machine and 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC washed, rinsed, and sanitized dishes.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Observed wet wiping cloths in 0 PPM of sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC re-made sanitizer solution during inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed chlorine dish machine dispensing 0 PPM of chlorine; observed sink and surface dispenser at 3 compartment sink dispensing 0 PPM of sanitizer during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC primed dish machine during inspection; observed chlorine at 50 PPM prior to end of inspection. PIC repaired sanitizer dispenser at 3 compartment sink; observed sanitizer at 200 PPM prior to end of inspection. Please test dish machine and sanitizer dispenser at a regular frequency.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. PIC UNABLE TO PROVIDE PERMIT TO POST IN A CONSPICUOUS LOCATION.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH PHONE NUMBER FOR FXHD TO INQUIRE ABOUT REPLACEMENT PERMIT. THIS MUST BE DONE AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1. OBSERVED UNDER COFFEE STATION: RAW LIQUID PASTEURIZED EGGS HELD IN CONTAINER ON ICE AT 56F (15MIN). 2. OBSERVED AT 4-DRAWER PREP TOP (3): SOPRESETTA AT 41F-45F(2HRS) 3. OBSERVED IN 4 DRAWER PREP TOP II (5): SLICED HAM AT 45F (2.25HR), SLICED ROMAINE LETTUCE AT 52F-53F(15-30MIN), SLICED COOKED CHICKEN AT 48F (2.25HR), AND SMOKED CHICKEN AT 44F (2.5HR) 4. OBSERVED FETA CHEESE IN 4-DRAWER PREP TOP (SALAD) (6) AT 43F-45F (45MIN).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. 1. CDI: EGG CONTAINERS SUBMERGED TO BRIM WITH ICE WATER. ADVISED PIC TO MONITOR TEMPERATURE. 2. CDI: SOPRESETTA PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER (1) TO PROPERLY COOL TO 41F. 3. CDI: ALL TCS ITEMS INCLUDING THE ITEMS LISTED ABOVE MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER (1). 4. CDI: FETA MOVED TO WALK-IN COOLER (1). PIC RE-EDUCATED ON COLD HOLDING AND MONITORING TEMPERATURES.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED IN PREP SINK: STEAK IN A BIN OF WATER (76F). PIC STATED IT WAS THAWING.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. CDI: STEAK REMOVED FROM WATER AND PLACED IN WALK-IN COOLER (1) TO THAW PROPERLY. CEASE USING ANY METHOD OF THAWING BESIDES THE ABOVE STATED METHODS.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control device is located over A SHELF STORING READY-TO-EAT FOOD ITEMS NEXT TO THE ENTRANCE TO THE KITCHEN FROM THE BACK where dead insects may be impelled or fall.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. PLEASE RELOCATE THIS INSECT CONTROL DEVICE PER THE REGULATION ABOVE - AS DISCUSSED, IT MAY BE PLACED ABOVE THE EMPLOYEE PERSONAL ITEM HOOKS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: OBSERVED A VAT OF PICKLES UNDERNEATH THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER FOR THE HANDWASHING SINK IN THE CATERING PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. CDI: PIC MOVED PICKLES AND FOOD WORKER WAS RE-EDUCATED ON NOT PLACING FOOD OR FOOD CONTACT SURFACES UNDERNEATH THE PAPER TOWEL DISPENSER.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the MOPSINK is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. OBSERVED UNAPPROVED SPLITTER INSTALLED ON THE MOP SINK WITH TWO HOSES ATTACHED.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. CDI: ONE HOSE REMOVED, PIC GIVEN INFORMATION ON HOW TO PURCHASE AN APPROVED PRESSURE BLEED VALVE. PANERA BREAD #705 (Inspection Date: 05/28/2025) Page 2 of 4
